Unpacking and installation
•
If the unit contains internal 
batteries, use a known-good DMM 
to make sure that power is not 
present in the cable terminals. 
•
There is a separate battery 
breaker for each string in the 
internal battery cabinet.

•

Unpacking and installation

Unpacking and installation
Measure and ensure there is no short circuit in the input connection 
terminals. 
Keep the input breaker open.
Measure and ensure there is no short circuit in the output connection 
terminal.

Make sure that the UPS input 
and bypass breakers (in case 
of dual input) are open.
Close the feed breaker(s) to 
apply utility and bypass power 
to the unit. (external breakers 
from facility)
Measure the voltage at input 
connection terminals:
Measure the voltages phase-
to-phase, phase-to-neutral, and 
phase-to-ground.
Make sure that the voltages 
are within the acceptable limits.
Make sure that there is less 
than 5 VAC from neutral-to-
ground.
Use a phase rotation meter (or 
similar) to make sure that the 
phase rotation is correct.
Close the UPS input and 
bypass switches. Close all 
battery breakers.
